sloka: विभीषणवचः कुर्याद्यदि स्म धनदानुजः।श्मशानभूता दुःखार्ता नेयं लङ्का पुरी भवेत् ।। ६.९५.२० ।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ kuryādyadi sma dhanadānujaḥ।śmaśānabhūtā duḥkhārtā neyaṁ laṅkā purī bhavet ।। 6.95.20 ।।

translations.english: "Good advice given by Vibheeshana in accordance with righteousness was not liked by him in delusion."
